questions.prompt: The exiled king preferred to die rather than to serve the enemy.
questions.answer: Rēx exsul morī māluit quam hostī servīre.

questions.prompt: We are unwilling to abandon the walls while the enemy threatens.
questions.answer: Mūrōs dēserere nōlumus dum hostis imminet.

questions.prompt: Why do you wish to conceal the truth from your friends?
questions.answer: Cūr vērum ab amīcīs occultāre vīs?

questions.prompt: The soldiers were unwilling to cross the river by night.
questions.answer: Mīlitēs flūmen nocte trānsīre nōlēbant.

questions.prompt: I would prefer to remain silent rather than to lie.
questions.answer: Tacēre māllem quam mentīrī.

questions.prompt: If you wished for peace, you would lay down your arms.
questions.answer: Sī pācem vellētis, arma dēpōnerētis.

questions.prompt: May the gods be willing to hear our prayers.
questions.answer: Dī nostrās precēs audīre velint.

questions.prompt: Do not wish to disturb the sleeping child.
questions.answer: Nōlī puerum dormientem turbāre.

questions.prompt: They were unwilling to reveal where the treasure had been hidden.
questions.answer: Ubi thēsaurus occultātus esset patefacere nōluērunt.

questions.prompt: We prefer to give generously rather than to be asked.
questions.answer: Līberāliter dare quam rogārī mālumus.

questions.prompt: At the banquet you prefer wine to water.
questions.answer: In epulō vīnum quam aquam māvīs.

questions.prompt: The senators did not wish to entrust power to one man.
questions.answer: Senātōrēs potestātem ūnī hominī committere nōluērunt.

questions.prompt: Whoever wishes to be free ought to fear nothing.
questions.answer: Quisquis līber esse vult nihil timēre dēbet.

questions.prompt: I shall prefer to praise silence rather than empty words.
questions.answer: Silentium quam inānia verba laudāre mālam.

questions.prompt: Had you wished to flee, the gates would have stood open.
questions.answer: Sī fugere voluissēs, portae patuissent.

questions.prompt: The rowers preferred a calm sea to a favorable wind.
questions.answer: Rēmigēs tranquillum mare quam secundum ventum māluērunt.

questions.prompt: Nobody wishes to be deceived by false hope.
questions.answer: Nēmō falsā spē dēcipī vult.

questions.prompt: We were unwilling to believe so great a crime.
questions.answer: Tantum scelus crēdere nōlēbāmus.

questions.prompt: The poet prefers to be read rather than to be praised.
questions.answer: Poēta legī quam laudārī māvult.

questions.prompt: Let us not be unwilling to help the afflicted wretches.
questions.answer: Nōlīmus miserōs afflīctōs adiuvāre.

questions.prompt: She wanted to know why her brother had remained silent.
questions.answer: Scīre voluit cūr frāter tacuisset.

questions.prompt: You do not wish to bear the burden of war any longer.
questions.answer: Onus bellī diūtius ferre nōn vultis.

questions.prompt: The general preferred to besiege the city rather than to lay waste the fields.
questions.answer: Dux urbem obsidēre quam agrōs vāstāre māluit.

questions.prompt: Do not wish to test the patience of the gods with idle boasting.
questions.answer: Nōlī deōrum patientiam vānā iactātiōne temptāre.

questions.prompt: Although wounded, the leader wished to lead his cohorts against the enemy.
questions.answer: Quamquam vulnerātus, dux cohortēs suās in hostem dūcere volēbat.

questions.prompt: We would prefer to endure hunger rather than to surrender the citadel.
questions.answer: Famem perferre quam arcem trādere māllēmus.

questions.prompt: You wish to be praised, yet you are unwilling to labor.
questions.answer: Laudārī vīs, sed tamen labōrāre nōn vīs.

questions.prompt: The helmsmen prefer to trust the stars rather than the deceiving clouds.
questions.answer: Gubernātōrēs stēllīs quam fallācibus nūbibus cōnfīdere mālunt.

questions.prompt: May you be willing to endure toil for the sake of lasting glory.
questions.answer: Velīs labōrem perpetuae glōriae causā perferre.

questions.prompt: The old man had wished to see his grandchildren before he died.
questions.answer: Senex nepōtēs suōs vidēre voluerat antequam morerētur.
